topic: Can you build muscle on a vegetarian diet?

slides.headline: You *can* build muscle on a vegetarian diet.

slides.label: SCIENCE
slides.headline: Muscles need *protein + training*, not meat.
items: Lift a little heavier over time.
Add a protein source to each meal.

slides.truth: Vegetarians build muscle the same way: train hard, eat enough protein.
